title: Sociocultural Considerations in Monitoring Anti-LGBTQ+ Content on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Applying anti-LGBTQ+ hate speech detection models trained on different open-source datasets (one culturally aligned with South Asia, one culturally undetermined) to real-world social media posts across various countries, comparing prediction rates and sensitivities between inner-circle and outer-circle national varieties of English.

Analyzing word-token and character-trigram frequencies in training datasets versus model predicted outputs to demonstrate how keyword-search data collection causes models to overfit to specific slurs prevalent in certain English dialects, leading to poor generalization across other regional varieties.
